ax_c.text(0.75, 4.75, 'Standard vs. EC-HTE Pipeline', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=NAVY, fontfamily='serif')

col_x = [2.5, 6.0, 9.5, 13.0]

strip_h = 1.5

ax_c.text(0.55, strip_y1 + strip_h/2, 'Standard', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=RED,
          rotation=90, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, subtitle, fill='white', border=ROSE_BORDER, text_color=NAVY, border_lw=1.2, subtitle_color=GRAY, text2=None):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border, linewidth=border_lw)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if text2:
        ax.text(x, y + 0.18, text, fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color=text_color, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif')
        ax.text(x, y - 0.02, text2, fontsize=8.5, color=text_color, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif')
        ax.text(x, y - 0.22, subtitle, fontsize=7.5, color=subtitle_color, ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic', fontfamily='sans-serif')
    else:
        ax.text(x, y + 0.1, text, fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color=text_color, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='serif')
        ax.text(x, y - 0.12, subtitle, fontsize=7.5, color=subtitle_color, ha='center', va='center', fontstyle='italic', fontfamily='sans-serif')
